newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman minister to head Cairo conference delegation.
newsitem.headline: Oman minister to head Cairo conference delegation.

text.p: Oman's minister of commerce and industry will head its delegation to the Cairo Middle East economic conference which aims at integrating Israel into the regional economy, an Omani official said on Sunday.
The official said the delegation headed by Makboul bin Ali bin Sultan would include members of Oman's chamber of commerce and industry representing the private sector.
Unlike most Gulf Arab states which have boycotted the Jewish state, Oman and Israel share limited trade ties.
The conference, scheduled for November 12-14, groups more than 85 countries and several international organisations.
Egypt has warned Israel that Arab participants might make difficulties for the Jewish state unless it made substantial progress in peace negotiations.
